g.text: run transport: pipes, signals and exit code through the image's PID 1
fd 0 is a pipe, not a TTY
the same bytes on the container's fd 0
inherited fd 0 (the entrypoint exec'd the agent)
exit code 42, or 128 + N when the agent died from signal N
tini reaps orphans and forwards to its direct child only, so the
agent's own grandchildren are not signalled; no TTY is in this path
agentjail-launcher is not in this path. images/base/Containerfile sets
and the entrypoint execs the agent, so tini is PID 1. Only an image whose
entrypoint execs the launcher reaches the launcher's own contract: refuse
root, exec the agent in its own process group, forward
SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGQUIT/SIGWINCH to that group, and exit with the agent's code
